note: Lebanon: the Gulf states' citizens enter without a visa for 6 months in a year, Jordanians 3 in 6 (the windows aren't modelled); nationals of the countries listed get a free visa on arrival for a month (extendable by two), if they hold a Lebanese phone number and address, a return ticket and no Israeli stamp. Everyone else needs a visa beforehand. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the General Security's lists.
